description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the Validator component of the OrangeHRM Core API Version 2. ValidatorTest extends TestCase and contains unit tests for validating data rules using the Validator class, including test cases with data providers for various validation scenarios.

classes.name: ValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Validator component in the OrangeHRM API, testing data validation logic with various data inputs and rules.

methods.name: testValidCases
methods.description: Runs validation tests on provided data and rule combinations to assert successful validation.

methods.name: validCasesDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various data sets and corresponding rules for testing the Validator's correctness.
